description: This file defines the CredentialsAmqpEndpoint class, an implementation of an AMQP endpoint for handling credential management requests as part of the Eclipse Hono project. It processes AMQP messages related to device credentials, creates event bus messages for processing, and constructs reply messages.

classes.name: CredentialsAmqpEndpoint
classes.description: A Vert.x endpoint for managing device credentials via AMQP, implementing the Credentials API, and facilitating message exchange between AMQP clients and the event bus.

methods.name: CredentialsAmqpEndpoint
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the endpoint with a Vert.x instance, ensuring it's non-null.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the endpoint's name identifier related to credentials.

methods.name: getEventBusServiceAddress
methods.description: Provides the address on the Vert.x event bus for incoming credentials messages.

methods.name: createEventBusRequestMessage
methods.description: Creates an EventBusMessage from an AMQP request message, embedding relevant identifiers and payload, handling JSON decoding errors.

methods.name: passesFormalVerification
methods.description: Verifies if the message passes formal validation for the specified resource link.

methods.name: getAmqpReply
methods.description: Constructs the AMQP reply message for a given event bus message.
